## Description

A tooth chart on the patient record and the consultation: FDI two-digit numbering, permanent, primary and mixed dentition, five surfaces per tooth, and conditions (caries, filling, crown, root canal treated, missing, implant, bridge, mobile, fractured). Each change is recorded with who, when and the visit, as part of the signed note.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A dentist can mark a condition on a tooth and surface with a mouse, a touch screen or the keyboard alone.
- [ ] **AC2.** A condition is shown by a symbol and words, never by colour alone (AGENTS.md 1.5).
- [ ] **AC3.** Signed findings are not edited; a correction is an addendum.
- [ ] **AC4.** Each new domain property carries a data classification; tenant isolation tests cover the new tables.
- [ ] **AC5.** Checked in a browser in English and Arabic (right to left keeps FDI numbers in their quadrants), axe clean.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
